title: Decreto 7-2013 Ley Marco para Regular la Reduccion de la Vulnerabilidad, la Adaptacion Obligatoria ante los Efectos del Cambio Climatico y la Mitigacion de Gases de Efecto Invernadero
citation: Decreto 7-2013 del Congreso de la República, Diario de Centro América of 2013-10-04 (Tomo CCXCVIII, No. 3)
evidence: Congreso's PDF is the gazette page set: masthead "Guatemala, VIERNES 4 de octubre 2013 - DIARIO de CENTRO AMÉRICA" and Art. 28: "Vigencia. La presente ley entrará en vigencia a los ocho días de su publicación en el Diario de Centro América." Eight days after 2013-10-04 is 2013-10-12; the date is computed, no page states it. Congreso's listing gives the emission date as Thursday, 05 September 2013. Opened https://www.congreso.gob.gt/assets/uploads/info_legislativo/decretos/2013/07-2013.pdf on 2026-11-03 (curl 200 application/pdf 1162782).
notes: Climate framework act. Art. 9 (national climate change information system): public and private entities must give MARN the climate information it requests, GHG emissions and reductions especially; the duty is on request, with no periodic report or threshold (F3 content). Art. 22 (carbon market projects) says the rights, tenure and trading of emission-reduction units will be regulated; no carbon-market regulation was found. Art. 28 sets entry into force. No general reglamento of the Ley Marco was found. Stored: one Spanish record (Spanish is the only official language of legislation), cut from the gazette page set of the Diario de Centro América of 2013-10-04 to PDF pages 1-5 (page 1 right column from the decree heading, pages 2-4 both columns, page 5 left column to the signatures; the page headers and the other decrees on those pages are left out). The text is uncorrected OCR output of a scanned official PDF (07-2013.pdf, 1162782 bytes, sha256 f9060da018c23d3e4d77e2fef39b9cdc2c47dd416229ab1c41e25a7ff0848d8a), tesseract 5.3.4 with the spa pack (tesseract-ocr-spa 1:4.1.0-2), 200 dpi, one column crop at a time; nothing was corrected, reflowed or reworded by hand, so expect recognition errors; the bold decree heading on page 1 is misread. Row GT-CONGRESO-ADOPTED passes under Decreto 33-98 art. 68 (ruling 2026-11-03). The PDF's own text layer was ignored. No government English translation was looked for beyond the Congreso, MARN and DCA sites, which list none.
